IMPORTANT CAVEAT FOR THE ANALYST: the near-total absence of any web, registry or court footprint for a claimed private limited company is itself a due-diligence flag worth escalating - it may indicate a very small/defunct entity, a name variant, or a non-existent legal entity. Per project rules, non-existence/defunct status is a rejection ground, but that determination belongs to the legal-identity researcher, not to me; I did not research CIN, PAN, incorporation status, HS codes or shipment volumes per my role. Recommend re-running sanctions screening (OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS) and MCA registry lookup once search tooling is restored, before any verdict is issued.
